blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper South: Established Family Living

parts.t: Chilliwack Proper South offers established neighbourhood charm with mature trees, excellent schools, and the family-oriented atmosphere that attracts dedicated parents. This well-maintained area features tree-lined streets with diverse housing from character homes to renovated properties and occasional newer builds, many on larger lots with established landscaping.

Residents appreciate proximity to top-rated schools including Sardis Secondary, walkability to parks and recreation facilities, plus the genuine community connections where neighbours know each other and children grow up together. The area provides convenient access to shopping along Vedder Road and downtown Chilliwack, plus dining and services meeting daily needs locally. Despite the established character, properties remain well-cared for reflecting pride of ownership throughout these neighbourhoods. Central location means quick access to outdoor recreation including Cultus Lake and Chilliwack River, while Highway 1 makes Fraser Valley commuting practical. blocks.text: Schools, Parks & Commuting in Chilliwack Proper South

parts.t: Families looking at homes for sale in Chilliwack Proper South are served by Robertson Elementary, McCammon Traditional Elementary, Bernard Elementary, Chilliwack Middle School, and Chilliwack Secondary School (46363 Yale Road) in SD33. Outdoor recreation and community amenities nearby include the Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre (aquatic centre and fitness rooms), Chilliwack Cultural Centre, Prospera Centre arena, Exhibition Field, and Central Community Park. For commuters and transit riders, the area is served by BC Transit Routes 51, 52, 57, and 58 along Yale Road and Young Road, with direct connection to Route 66 Fraser Valley Express at the Downtown Exchange.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper South Real Estate FAQs

parts.t: What types of homes are for sale in Chilliwack Proper South?

Active MLS® listings in Chilliwack Proper South typically include detached single-family homes on 6,000+ sq ft lots, updated rancher and split-level homes, townhome complexes, low-rise apartment condos, and infill subdivision lots. All listings at the top of this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed.
Which schools serve Chilliwack Proper South in Chilliwack School District 33?

Robertson Elementary, McCammon Traditional Elementary and Bernard Elementary are the SD33 elementary schools serving or close to Chilliwack Proper South, along with Chilliwack Middle School and Chilliwack Secondary School at 46363 Yale Road. Catchment boundaries in SD33 follow the street address, so check the specific property in the official locator, the SD33 School Locator, ahead of removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near Chilliwack Proper South?

Residents of Chilliwack Proper South have access to the Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre (aquatic centre and fitness rooms), Chilliwack Cultural Centre, Prospera Centre arena, Exhibition Field, and Central Community Park. See our
Chilliwack Proper South Neighbourhood Guide
for detailed park addresses and trail notes.
How are roads, highway access, and public transit in Chilliwack Proper South?

Key road corridors serving Chilliwack Proper South include Yale Road, Nowell Street, Spadina Avenue, Chilliwack Central Road, and Young Road north of Highway 1. Public transit connections include BC Transit Routes 51, 52, 57, and 58 along Yale Road and Young Road, with direct connection to Route 66 Fraser Valley Express at the Downtown Exchange.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or hazard rules apply in Chilliwack Proper South?

Properties in Chilliwack Proper South are governed by the Chilliwack 2050 Official Community Plan and Downtown/Proper urban residential infill policies supporting secondary suites, coach houses, and multi-unit infill near transit corridors. Before writing an offer, check the parcel's exact zoning, Development Permit Area overlays, and floodplain elevation requirements.
Are homes in Chilliwack Proper South freehold or leasehold?

In Chilliwack Proper South, most residential properties are held freehold (fee simple) or as freehold strata. Some developments across the Chilliwack and Cultus Lake region more broadly are on prepaid leasehold land instead. Each MLS® listing has a Title Type field that shows which, and your Realtor and lawyer should review the title search with you.
